review.evidence: Compared the source with decoded frames at 0, 4.5, 8.7083 and 8.9583 seconds, including the native-resolution energy crops. People, hands, grip, steel blades and background geometry remain visually stationary. No lettering is visible. The cyan aura remains present at the last in-state sample. Its arch shows slight brightness and contour variation, but these sparse samples do not clearly establish traveling ripple/flow or repetition beyond the first cycle. The next-state frames at 9 and 9.4583 seconds show no carried-over cyan aura. No obvious detached duplicate wisps, protected-edge discontinuities or clean-plate seams are visible. Fixed framing fits the composition; no added camera motion, heat refraction or transition effect is apparent. Findings apply only to supplied samples.
issues: Visible flowing or rippling energy, distinguishable from slight shimmer and compression differences, is not conclusively demonstrated.
